The '''Schinga Tracks''' were a rectangular structure in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Thousand Thousand]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. The tracks shared their name with [[schinga]], several [[Species/Legends|species]] of large [[Snake/Legends|serpent]] domesticanted by Makem Te's native [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]].<ref name="GatORW" />
